title: Token Push Provisioned event
description: Event emitted when a token is push-provisioned, carrying the issuer/TSP references.

expire_timestamp.description: The date time that the push-provisioning reference expires, after which a request based on it will fail.

is_pass_code_required.description: Whether OTP step up is required. Y - OTP required; N - OTP not required.

ref.description: Reference to the payment instrument. Maximum 256 characters.

tsp.description: Token service provider. V - Visa; MC - Mastercard; empty when unknown.
